about_the_game:
MISSING YOUR FAVORITE VIGILANTE?  HE'S BEEN MISSING YOU TOO...

Show the Killer Chat! team some love this Valentine's day and you'll get some exclusive rewards from your murderous lover in these Valentine's day bundles! 

I invested my own money and the games' earnings so far to pay the team, and I need your help to continue to fund the team's hard work. Donate through one of our bundles below for some extra serial killer loving while we work on more game content!

IN THIS V-THEMED BUNDLE, YOU GET...

༯ x1 LOVE LETTER

  • Receive a love letter from V (pdf).

༯ x1 VOICE-ACTED LOVE LETTER!

  • Watch V read his love letter out loud! (mp4 video file; voiced by Jason Hall).

༯ x1 SHORT STORY 

  • Receive a Valentine's short story about a date with V (pdf).

Looking for another serial killer to keep you company?

Check out what our other love interests have to offer!

CAN'T CHOOSE JUST ONE VALENTINE? 

If you want all 4 bundles, save money by buying the Ultimate Valentine's Bundle to get the content from ALL 4 character bundles!

Includes:

༯ Love letters for all 4 love interests!
༯ Ronin, Angel, Misaki and V's voiced love letters.
༯ Exclusive Ronin Valentine's art!
༯ 4 Valentine's short stories!

THANK YOU!

Every cent makes a huge difference in being able to continue with this project, so thank you for your support rotterlings!

HAVE A KILLER TIME WITH YOUR BLOODY VALENTINE!

And as always, don't forget to review the bundle if you loved it!
